description: AI-generated sprite sheets to replace the 40 base character models (assets/placeholder/char/*.svg, not the _field variants). Four characters per sheet, each facing the viewer, on a #FF00FF key background.
generator: Arena Agent Mode image generation (text-to-image, no reference images), one call per sheet

format.layout: 2 x 2 grid; slots top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right; one full-body character per slot
format.background_cleanup: The generator's background was about (249, 3, 246). Pixels within 40 of pure magenta were set to exact #FF00FF. No figure pixels were changed.
format.shadows: none (the game's rig draws its own shadow)

style: Woodcut ink on parchment with hatched shading, colour only for blood, fire and gold, matching the placeholder art direction. Ser Gauntley (sheet 05) is the only fully coloured figure, as in the README.

sheets.theme: Derrick through the years (the four Derrick forms)
sheets.prompt:
A sprite sheet of four separate full-body game characters, one per quadrant of a 2 by 2 grid. Chunky proportions like a placeholder game sprite: large head, compact torso, short legs. Characters, left to right, top to bottom:
- Derrick as a small boy of about seven: shaggy dark hair, plain pale tunic, a short wooden sword held in his right hand.
- Derrick as a thin youth of about thirteen: shaggy hair, ragged dark clothes, a wooden sword tucked in his belt, a sad face.
- Derrick as a slight young man of about sixteen: shaggy hair, plain tunic with darker sleeves, a stick in his right hand, a wooden sword in his belt, a stern face.
- Derrick as an adult of twenty-one: padded gambeson with a few small red blood spots, stubble, shaggy hair, a knife in his right hand, a wooden sword in his belt, a stern face.
Style: woodcut and wood-engraving illustration, bold black ink outlines, parallel hatching and cross-hatching for shading, parchment-cream and brown tones, grim medieval folk-art feel. Colour only for blood, fire and gold accents. Front view only: every figure faces the viewer straight on, body, face and both shoulders square to the viewer, both eyes visible, arms relaxed. No profile, no back view, no three-quarter turn. All figures stand on a common ground line. Background: one flat, uniform, pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere outside the figures, with no gradient, texture, vignette, floor or cast shadow. Leave a wide empty magenta margin around each figure so no two figures touch or overlap and no figure is cropped. No text, numbers, labels, frames or borders.
